# AWS Elemental MediaConvert

Manage queues, custom presets and job templates and exercise a durable local job lifecycle without transcoding.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| --- | --- |

| Wire protocol | REST JSON |

| Scope | Account and region |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-elemental-mediaconvert) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No transcoding, probing or output media/manifest files: COMPLETE means local input objects existed, regardless of their bytes or codec.
- Only custom presets/templates are listed; no system preset/template catalog, reserved pricing, acceleration, queue hopping or inference feeds.
- Only profiled settings are accepted: S3 FileInput, basic input selectors, file output groups, MP4/container/video H264/audio AAC configuration, timecode and ad-avail offset; other model members fail explicitly.
- No HTTP input fetching, output object writes, codec validation, IAM data-plane permission simulation or periodic STATUS_UPDATE events; StatusUpdateInterval is stored.
- EventBridge publishing is best effort after commit; no transactional outbox/replay guarantee.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
